notes: Cases marked scored=true count toward pass/fail. Exploratory cases are recorded for human review and never pass or fail. reference_sql is an oracle run against the CSV (never shown to the model); expected_cells are the values a correct result set must contain.

cases.question: What is total revenue across the dataset?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM uploaded_data

cases.question: Which region has the highest total revenue?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM uploaded_data GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

cases.question: Which category generated the most gross profit?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(gross_profit), 2) AS gross_profit FROM uploaded_data GROUP BY category ORDER BY gross_profit DESC

cases.question: Which month had the highest revenue?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT substr(transaction_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM uploaded_data GROUP BY month ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

cases.question: How did first-half revenue change from 2025 to 2026?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT substr(transaction_date, 1, 4) AS year, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS h1_revenue FROM uploaded_data WHERE substr(transaction_date, 6, 2) <= '06' AND substr(transaction_date, 1, 4) IN ('2025', '2026') GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

cases.question: How many transactions have an unknown customer segment?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing FROM uploaded_data WHERE customer_segment IS NULL

cases.question: Does a return by itself require escalation?
answer_quotes: does not by itself require escalation

cases.question: How many transactions meet the policy fulfillment escalation rule?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM uploaded_data WHERE fulfillment_days >= 10

cases.question: How many transactions meet at least one documented review rule?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM uploaded_data WHERE discount_rate >= 0.30 OR gross_margin_rate < 0.10 OR fulfillment_days >= 10

cases.question: And which region has the lowest total revenue?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM uploaded_data GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_revenue ASC
